label: Bible Study
prompt: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and _____,
verse: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
note: Job's first response to losing everything — grief, and then worship, before a single word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not _____ from every one of us:
verse: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
note: Paul tells the philosophers of Athens that God isn't hiding — He's not far from any one of us.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and _____ up the water that was in the trench.
verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
note: On Mount Carmel the fire fell and even licked up the water Elijah had poured into the trench.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Remove not the ancient _____, which thy fathers have set.
verse: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
note: Boundary stones marked family land; moving one at night was quiet theft of a neighbor's inheritance.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD will perfect that which _____ me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verse: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
note: 'The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me' — he finishes what he starts, Philippians 1:6 in psalm form.
